content.rendered:
? Part 2
?
Genesis 26:25 MSG
…He pitched his tent and his servants started digging another well.
Genesis 26:32 Later that same day, Isaac’s servants came to him with news about the well they had been digging, ” We’ve struck water!”

?V25 said, ” his servants started digging another well” from the narrative, they had issues with the previous well dug…things did not go the way they planned it. Antagonists were allover them trying to “weaken” their hands.
?
You may have given it your best shot, but things did not turn out the way you wanted…rather than gain acceptance, your work, job or business only attracted opposition.
?
The good thing about this is that, Isaac’s servants did not stop inspite of opposition. They kept on digging. You too should

?V32 says, “Later that same day, Isaac’s servants came to him with news about the well they had been digging, ” We’ve struck water!”
?
Later that same day, not the next day not the third day. It’s your day…today is your same day..

?That approval you have Been trusting God for will bring the desired result later today.

?Your expectations from that job or Bid interview will bring desired results later today..

?That unpleasant results you have been getting daily from the hospital will bring an entirely different but pleasant result later today.

?That marriage that has rendered all your goodly and godly efforts fruitless will yield expected result later today.

?Later today, all your efforts both great and small will bring desired results…you will ” strike water ” in Jesus name
